name: Euless Town Center
summary: Euless Town Center is a community shopping destination conveniently located on Airport Freeway in the Mid-Cities area of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. With strong community ratings and extended daily hours, it serves as a reliable hub for everyday shopping needs in Euless and surrounding communities.
demographics: Euless Town Center serves a diverse middle-class demographic in the Mid-Cities area of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, attracting families and professionals with median household incomes ranging from $55,000 to $85,000. The primary trade area includes residents from Euless, Bedford, and Hurst, with a strong representation of households aged 25-54 with children. The center's proximity to DFW Airport also draws airport employees and travelers seeking convenient shopping options. Visitors typically engage in convenience-oriented shopping patterns, combining grocery runs with quick service dining and essential retail purchases.
description: Euless Town Center is a well-established community shopping destination strategically located at 1201 Airport Freeway in the heart of Euless, Texas, serving the Mid-Cities region of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. This open-air shopping center has become a cornerstone of the local community, offering residents convenient access to everyday shopping needs and services. With its prime location near DFW International Airport and major transportation corridors, the center benefits from high visibility and accessibility for both local residents and the broader regional market. The center maintains strong community connections with a solid 4.2-star rating from over 2,200 Google reviews, reflecting its consistent service to the area. Operating daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Euless Town Center provides extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of working families and professionals in this dynamic suburban market.
